<!--
New contributor? See CONTRIBUTING.md first — this project reviews every PR
against methods/falsification-standard.md, not just for whether the code runs.
-->

### What this changes and why

### If this is a statistical result or reproduction
- [ ] Checksums/source pins recorded for any external data used
- [ ] Null result reported honestly if that's what happened (a null is a real finding here, not a failure)
- [ ] Any assumption or approximation disclosed, not smoothed over
- [ ] `knowledge-base/state.md` is untouched, or the change follows `methods/falsification-standard.md`

### If this is a sidequest or documentation change
- [ ] `INDEX.md` updated if a new file was added
- [ ] No silent edit to an append-only file (`comms/`, `logs/`, `knowledge-base/state.md` history) — corrections are new entries, not rewrites
